properties.query: let NextDNS_Parser = () { NextDNS_CL | extend EventVendor='NextDNS', EventProduct='NextDNS', EventSchema='Dns', EventSchemaVersion='0.1.0', EventType='DnsQuery' | extend Dvc=tostring(deviceName), SrcIpAddr=tostring(clientIp), DnsQuery=tostring(domain), DnsQueryDomain=tostring(root), DnsQueryTypeName=tostring(queryType), NetworkProtocol=tostring(protocol), EventResult=iff(tolower(tostring(status)) == 'blocked', 'Failure', 'Success'), EventResultDetails=tostring(status) | extend AdditionalFields=bag_pack('ProfileId', tostring(profileId), 'Reasons', tostring(reasons), 'Encrypted', tobool(encrypted), 'Client', tostring(client), 'Tracker', tostring(tracker), 'Device', device) | project TimeGenerated, EventVendor, EventProduct, EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventType, EventResult, EventResultDetails, Dvc, SrcIpAddr, DnsQuery, DnsQueryDomain, DnsQueryTypeName, NetworkProtocol, AdditionalFields, RawData }; NextDNS_Parser

let NextDNSAnalytics_Parser = () { NextDNSAnalytics_CL | extend EventVendor='NextDNS', EventProduct='NextDNS' | extend itemName=iff(isnotempty(name), name, status) | project TimeGenerated, EventVendor, EventProduct, profileId, metric, itemName, queryCount, percentage }; NextDNSAnalytics_Parser

properties.description: NextDNS blocked domain spike analytics rule
Detect unusual spikes in blocked DNS events from NextDNS.
NextDNS potential DNS tunneling analytics rule
Detect high unique-query volume to the same root domain from a single source over a short period.
properties.query:
let recentWindow = 15m;
NextDNS_Parser()
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(recentWindow)
| where EventSchema =~ 'Dns'
| summarize TotalQueries = count(), UniqueQueries = dcount(DnsQuery), SampleQueries = make_set(DnsQuery, 10) by ProfileId = tostring(AdditionalFields.ProfileId), SrcIpAddr, DnsQueryDomain, Dvc
| where UniqueQueries >= 50 and TotalQueries >= 200
| project TimeGenerated = now(), ProfileId, SrcIpAddr, Dvc, DnsQueryDomain, TotalQueries, UniqueQueries, SampleQueries

properties.description: NextDNS newly observed domain burst analytics rule
Detect spikes in domains not seen in the prior baseline window, potentially indicating phishing or malware infrastructure churn.
NextDNS malicious category blocked surge analytics rule
Detect repeated blocked DNS queries tied to high-risk categories such as malware, phishing, botnet, cryptomining, and C2-like indicators.
properties.query:
NextDNS_Parser()
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(15m)
| where EventSchema =~ 'Dns' and EventResult =~ 'Failure'
| extend ProfileId = tostring(AdditionalFields.ProfileId), Reasons = tolower(tostring(AdditionalFields.Reasons))
| where Reasons has 'malware' or Reasons has 'phishing' or Reasons has 'botnet' or Reasons has 'cryptomining' or Reasons has 'rebind' or Reasons has 'newly registered' or Reasons has 'c2'
| summarize BlockedCount = count(), SampleDomains = make_set(DnsQuery, 10), SampleReasons = make_set(Reasons, 5) by ProfileId, SrcIpAddr, Dvc
| where BlockedCount >= 10
| project TimeGenerated = now(), ProfileId, SrcIpAddr, Dvc, BlockedCount, SampleDomains, SampleReasons

properties.description: NextDNS analytics malicious reason concentration analytics rule
Detect high-volume blocked reason categories from analytics aggregates to quickly identify broad threat campaigns.
properties.query:
NextDNSAnalytics_Parser()
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(2h)
| where metric == 'reasons'
| extend reason = tolower(itemName)
| where reason has 'malware' or reason has 'phishing' or reason has 'botnet' or reason has 'cryptomining' or reason has 'c2'
| summarize blockedQueries = sum(queryCount), maxPct = max(percentage) by profileId, reason
| where blockedQueries >= 200
| project TimeGenerated = now(), profileId, reason, blockedQueries, maxPct
